title: Beautiful plus quality.
text: Beautiful plus quality.. One of the most beautiful pans I ever saw. Besides this it is well made, I compared it to my other pan and you can not compare the quality of this product, it is just great. I am a cook and appreciate great cookware, I am so happy I ordered this pan, I can use it in the oven and on the stove.  the pan is so beautiful you can use it to service at the table. Recommend it highly.
